	<section 		class="about-content pt-8 sm:pt-8 md:pt-72px pb-8 sm:pb-8 md:pb-72px bg-[var(--bg-color)] text-[var(--text-color)]"

		<div class="container max-w-1144px">
							<h2 class="mb-8 md:mb-12 text-30px sm:text-43px md:text-55px leading-[1.09] tracking-[-1.3px]">
					Connection is our calling. It’s yours, too.				</h2>
						<div
				class="sm:text-lg leading-[1.5] prose-p:mb-28px prose-a:font-bold prose-a:underline prose-a:underline-offset-4 prose-ol:mb-8 prose-ol:pl-5 prose-ol:list-decimal prose-ul:mb-8 [&_ul_li]:relative [&_ul_li]:pl-26px [&_ul_li]:before:content-['→'] [&_ul_li]:before:absolute [&_ul_li]:before:left-0 prose-headings:mb-2 prose-headings:!font-ftregolaneue prose-headings:text-base sm:prose-headings:text-lg sm:prose-headings:leading-[1.56] prose-headings:font-semibold last:[&_*]:mb-0 prose-strong:font-semibold [&_b]:font-semibold ">
				<p>Together, we power advertising that enables billions of people to stay informed, entertained, and connected. We introduce them to new ideas, products, and services that make their lives better. And we help media owners of all sizes realize their full potential.</p>
<p>That’s a lot — that’s the power of advertising. But it’s only possible with great technology. And that’s where Magnite comes in.</p>
<p>Since our very beginning, we’ve strived for the kind of innovation that brings people together — that means giving media owners the tools and guidance they need to thrive, and robust connections to the world’s top advertisers. We’re the only one operating at this scale that’s independent of the influence of a parent company and other self-serving conflicts of interest. At Magnite, our interest starts with what’s best for our clients, and what leads to long-lasting partnerships. So, what does that look like?</p>
<p>You can see it in our roots — how, over the years, we’ve continued to invent and assemble the kind of technology that can reach people wherever they are, however, they’re watching. You’ll find it in our footprint across the globe, where we develop the most nuanced knowledge of different communities because we’re committed to having our people on the ground, working in them. It’s yours, too. Together, we power advertising that enables billions of people to stay informed, entertained, and connected. We introduce them to new ideas, products, and services that make their lives better. And we help media owners of all sizes realize their full potential. That’s a lot — that’s the power of advertising. But it’s only possible with great technology. And that’s where Magnite comes in. Since our very beginning, we’ve strived for the kind of innovation that brings people together — that means giving media owners the tools and guidance they need to thrive, and robust connections to the world’s top advertisers. We’re the only one operating at this scale that’s independent of the influence of a parent company and other self-serving conflicts of interest. At Magnite, our interest starts with what’s best for our clients, and what leads to long-lasting partnerships. So, what does that look like? You can see it in our roots — how, over the years, we’ve continued to invent and assemble the kind of technology that can reach people wherever they are, however, they’re watching. You’ll find it in our footprint across the globe, where we develop the most nuanced knowledge of different communities because we’re committed to having our people on the ground, working in them. And you’ll sense it every time you meet with a member of our team, who’s attuned to your needs and attentive anytime, well, life happens. We’re real people you can be real with. An innovative, independent spirit that’s earned the industry’s trust. <p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Table of Contents</strong>:<br><a href="#about-us">About Us<br></a><a href="#how-we-collect-user-information">How We Collect User Information<br></a><a href="#information-our-clients-and-vendors-collect-independently">Information Our Clients and Vendors Collect Independently<br></a><a href="#use-of-user-information">Use of User Information<br></a><a href="#cooperation-with-clients-in-the-european-union">Cooperation with Clients in the European Union<br></a><a href="#information-we-collect-use-disclose-and-the-purposes-for-such-disclosure">User Information We Collect, Use, Disclose, and the Purposes for such Disclosure<br></a><a href="#your-privacy-rights-and-choices">Your Privacy Rights and Choices<br></a><a href="#additional-information-for-residents-of-certain-states">Additional Information for Residents of Certain States<br></a><a href="#information-retention">Information Retention<br></a><a href="#security">Security</a><br><a href="#self-regulatory-mechanisms">Industry Frameworks & Self-regulatory Mechanisms<br></a><a href="#data-transfers-and-eu-u-s-data-privacy-framework-uk-extension-to-the-eu-us-data-privacy-framework-and-swiss-u-s-data-privacy-principles">Data Transfers and EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, UK Extension to the EU-US Data Privacy Framework, and Swiss-U.S Data Privacy Principles</a><br><a href="#international-data-transfers-from-brazil">International Data Transfers from Brazil<br></a><a href="#changes-to-this-policy">Changes to this Policy<br></a><a href="#contact-us">Contact Us</a></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">This policy explains how Magnite, Inc. and its affiliates (“<strong>Magnite</strong>”, “<strong>we</strong>” or “<strong>us</strong>”) collects, uses and discloses information about you when you interact with Digital Media Properties (defined below) that use our advertising technology platforms and related services to deliver you ads (collectively, the “<strong>Services</strong>”).  </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">This privacy policy does not govern (i) the collection and use of information about visitors to our <a href="https://www.magnite.com/"><strong>website</strong></a>, or (ii) information collected in the course of our sales and marketing activities. Our privacy practices as to that information can be found <a href="https://www.magnite.com/legal/magnite-website-privacy-policy/"><strong>here</strong></a>.<strong>This policy does not cover how our Clients collect, use, or share information through their own Digital Media Properties</strong>. It also does not apply to the activities of other third parties we may work with, or any activities where we act as a service provider or processor to our Clients rather than a data controller. Those practices are governed by our Clients’ own privacy policies.</p>


<section class="core-heading"><div class="container max-w-1144px">
<h1 class="wp-block-heading" id="about-us"><strong>About Us</strong></h1>
</div></section>


<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Magnite offers Services that connect buyers of advertising inventory (which we refer to as advertisers) with sellers of advertising inventory (which we refer to as publishers), providing such advertisers with the opportunity to display an advertisement on a publisher’s Digital Media Property. In this policy, we refer to our advertisers and publishers that use our Services collectively as “<strong>Clients</strong>”. Our platform is used to deliver digital advertising inventory on websites and applications across internet-connected devices and platforms, including mobile devices, computers and internet-connected TVs (which we refer to as “<strong>Digital</strong> <strong>Media              Properties”</strong>).</p>


<section class="core-heading"><div class="container max-w-1144px">
<h1 class="wp-block-heading" id="how-we-collect-user-information"><strong>How We Collect User Information</strong></h1>
</div></section>


<p class="wp-block-paragraph">We (and our vendors) use different technologies (“<strong>Tracking Technologies</strong>”), including cookies and other similar technologies to collect information automatically from your device when you visit a Digital Media Property that uses our technology. </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">When doing so, we collect certain information about you and your device (“<strong>User Information</strong>”). User Information does not include information that directly identifies an individual, such as name, address, phone number, or email address. However, the User Information we collect is considered “personal data” or “personal information” under applicable privacy and data protection laws.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">In particular, we collect information such as your IP address, cookie data, and other device identifiers, and may also assign new identifiers to your device or browser based on this data and other device-related information we collect as described in more detail <a href="#table-1"><strong>here</strong></a>. These identifiers help us to recognize a particular device without knowing the identity of the user of that device. This helps us, our Clients, and our partners (such as third party advertising platforms) select appropriate advertisements to display to you.</p>


<section class="core-heading"><div class="container max-w-1144px">
<h1 class="wp-block-heading" id="information-our-clients-and-vendors-collect-independently"><strong>Information Our Clients and Vendors Collect Independently </strong></h1>
</div></section>


<p class="wp-block-paragraph">We collaborate with various third-parties for analytics and advertising services, which independently gather and use User Information. These third-party services provide our Clients with additional ways to deliver targeted ads using our technology.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">For example, third-party companies may use data about your visits to Digital Media Properties across multiple devices or browsers to create advertising profiles that allow advertisers to deliver more personalized content and ads. Our advertiser clients can combine this data with the information we collect to deliver targeted ads or create audience segments for advertising on Digital Media Properties.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Please review our <a href="https://www.magnite.com/legal/platform-cookie-policy/"><strong>Platform Partner Statement</strong></a> for more information.</p>


<section class="core-heading"><div class="container max-w-1144px">
<h1 class="wp-block-heading" id="use-of-user-information"><strong>Use of User Information</strong></h1>
</div></section>


<p class="wp-block-paragraph">We and our Clients use User Information to guide decisions on buying and selling advertising space on Digital Media Properties. This data, which may also be combined with information from third-party services, helps deliver targeted ads that our Clients believe will interest specific users. When an ad is shown on a publisher’s Digital Media Property, it may also be targeted based on the content that you are viewing or have viewed, for example a travel ad appearing on a travel site. Tracking Technologies help to match Client’s advertising opportunities with relevant advertisements. To aid with ad targeting, we may perform cookie syncing between Clients, Magnite, and third party data providers and assist Clients in matching the IDs they hold to other IDs. This cookie synching process allows the parties to map their respective cookie information. For example, if publisher A sets a cookie on a user’s device with an ID 12345 and advertiser B sets a cookie on the same user’s device with an ID 67890, this process allows  publisher A and advertiser B to recognize that ID 12345 and ID 67890 relate to the same user’s device. In the case of advertisers, this process may influence the decision whether to bid on a specific advertising opportunity, because if an advertiser recognizes a given cookie ID it may place a higher value on that opportunity. </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">We also use these Tracking Technologies for frequency capping, which helps prevent users from seeing the same ad repeatedly, enhancing ad delivery, report to clients, and assess ad effectiveness.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The use and processing of User Information described in this section may constitute “targeted advertising” under some laws and the “sale” or “sharing” of personal information under other laws.</p>


<section class="core-heading"><div class="container max-w-1144px">
<h1 class="wp-block-heading" id="cooperation-with-clients-in-the-european-union"><strong>Cooperation with Clients in the European Union</strong></h1>
</div></section>


<p class="wp-block-paragraph">In the European Union, we and our Clients may, in limited circumstances, act as joint controllers under the GDPR for the collection of User Information on Digital Media Properties. In this case, this joint controllership is limited to setting and collecting identifiers and User Information on the Digital Media Properties and transmitting this information to us (“<strong>Joint Processing</strong>“). Further processing of your information is our sole responsibility and we act as an independent controller.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">We have put contractual arrangements in place with our Clients that set out the distribution of responsibilities between us and our Client. Accordingly, our Clients establish the necessary legal basis for this Joint Processing by obtaining consent on the Digital Media Properties and providing the required transparency information. We and our Clients cooperate to fulfill our obligations under the GDPR, especially regarding collaboration with data protection authorities and data subject rights. </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">If you wish to exercise your rights under the GDPR concerning Joint Processing, please contact us via the <a href="https://www.magnite.com/legal/user-choice-portal/"><strong>User Choice Portal</strong></a>.</p>


<section class="core-heading"><div class="container max-w-1144px">
<h1 class="wp-block-heading" id="information-we-collect-use-disclose-and-the-purposes-for-such-disclosure"><strong>User</strong> <strong>Information We Collect, Use, Disclose, and the Purposes for such Disclosure:</strong></h1>
</div></section>


<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Types of User Information we collect:</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Depending on the Digital Media Properties you visit and how they interact with our Services, we may process the following categories of User Information:                                             </p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li><strong>Device Characteristics</strong>: device identifiers, IP addresses, hashed versions of email addresses, probabilistic identifiers and other advertising identifiers.</li>



<li><strong>Browsing and Interaction Data</strong>: information about the domain, topic or name of the property, the date/time of visits, visitor activities and actions, viewability data, video player size, description or category being displayed, click data, types of advertisements viewed, type of browser you use, app version, and the page you visited before navigating to the Digital Media Properties.</li>



<li><strong>Users</strong><strong> Profiles, User behavior data, derived information</strong>: user demographics, information with respect to a user’s preferences, patterns, clicks, behaviors or interests, and information provided to us by advertisers and advertising platforms to match an advertisement opportunity offered by our Clients with the right advertisement.</li>



<li><strong>Non-precise Location data: </strong>An approximation of a location, such as country and/or city, state/province using the IP address.</li>



<li><strong>Precise Location Data</strong> (which is “sensitive personal information” under certain State Privacy Laws): An approximation of a location within a radius of 1850 feet or less. It will be used only with your consent and in jurisdictions where permitted.</li>
</ul>

<section class="core-heading"><div class="container max-w-1144px">
<h1 class="wp-block-heading" id="your-privacy-rights-and-choices"><strong>Your Privacy Rights and Choices</strong></h1>
</div></section>


<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Opt-Out</span></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Depending upon where you live, certain activities described <strong><a href="#table-1">here</a></strong> may constitute “sharing” “selling” or processing of User Information for purposes of “targeted advertising” as such terms are defined under certain privacy laws. You may opt out of these activities, as well as processing of any sensitive personal information we may undertake by following the instructions in our <a href="https://www.magnite.com/legal/user-choice-portal/"><strong>User Choice Portal</strong></a>, or by using a legally recognized universal opt out mechanism such as the <a href="https://globalprivacycontrol.org/">Global Privacy Control</a>.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Note that because these opt outs are specific to the device or browser on which they are exercised, you will need to opt out on each browser and device you use.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Access, Deletion, Correction, Portability, Withdrawal of Consent & other Rights</span></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Depending on where you reside and other legal limitations, you may have the right to (i) request to know more about and access the categories and specific pieces of User Information we collect, use, and disclose, (ii) request deletion or restriction of your User Information, (iii) request correction of inaccurate User Information, (iv) obtain your User Information in a portable format, (v) if the processing is based on our legitimate interest, object to the processing and/or (vi) if the processing of User Information is based on your consent, withdraw your consent at any time, (vii) confirm the existence of processing, as applicable. </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">If you would like to exercise any of these rights, please see our <a href="https://www.magnite.com/legal/user-choice-portal/"><strong>User Choice Portal</strong></a> for instructions on how to do so. If you are a resident of California or of the EEA, you may also exercise these rights using an authorized agent. We may ask the agent to present signed written permission to act on your behalf and you may also be required to independently verify your identity. If you are an agent seeking to make a request, please contact us <a href="/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#8dfdffe4fbeceef4cde0eceae3e4f9e8a3eee2e0">here</a>.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">We will not discriminate against you for exercising these rights. Note that when you exercise your rights, we may ask for additional information to verify your request.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><em>Right to Lodge a Complaint if you are a User in the EEA, UK, or Switzerland</em>:</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">You have the right to lodge a complaint about our processing of personal data with a European Data Protection Authority. For contact details of EU data protection authorities, please see <a href="https://edpb.europa.eu/about-edpb/about-edpb/members_en"><strong>here</strong></a>. The UK data protection authority can be contacted <a href="https://ico.org.uk"><strong>here</strong></a>. The Swiss data protection authority can be contacted <a href="https://www.edoeb.admin.ch/en/contact-2"><strong>here</strong></a>.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><em>If you are a User in Brazil</em>:</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">You have the right to lodge a complaint about our processing of personal data with the National Data Protection Agency (ANPD). For contact details of the ANPD, please see<a href="https://www.gov.br/anpd/pt-br/canais_atendimento"> <strong>here</strong></a>.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Y<em>our Rights under certain State Laws</em></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">If you are a resident of a state governed by a <a href="https://www.magnite.com/legal/advertising-platform-privacy-policy/#additional-information-for-residents-of-certain-states"><strong>State Privacy Law</strong></a>, please see our <a href="https://www.magnite.com/legal/user-choice-portal/"><strong>User Choice Portal</strong></a><strong> </strong>section above to exercise your rights. If we deny your request, you may have the right to appeal our decision by contacting us <a href="/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#7505071c0314160c351814121b1c01105b161a18"><strong>here</strong></a>. If you have concerns about the result of an appeal, you may contact the attorney general in the state where you reside.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><em>Authorized Agents</em></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Depending upon where you live, you may also submit a rights request through an authorized agent. If you do so, the agent must present signed written permission to act on your behalf and you may also be required to independently verify your identity. If you are an agent seeking to make a request, please contact us <a href="/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#a9d9dbc0dfc8cad0e9c4c8cec7c0ddcc87cac6c4"><strong>here</strong></a>.</p>


<section class="core-heading"><div class="container max-w-1144px">
<h1 class="wp-block-heading" id="additional-information-for-residents-of-certain-states"><strong>Additional Information for Residents of Certain States</strong></h1>
</div></section>


<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Certain states, including Alabama, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Indiana, Kentucky, Louisiana, Iowa, Minnesota, Maryland, Montana, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Jersey, Oklahoma, Oregon, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, and Virginia, have enacted consumer privacy laws that grant their residents certain rights and require additional disclosures (“<strong>State Privacy Laws</strong>”). If you are a resident of a state governed by a State Privacy Law this section applies to you. This section also serves as our California Notice at Collection. As a reminder, disclosures do not apply to the extent we act as a service provider or processor to our Clients. In such cases, you must visit the privacy policies of our Clients to understand how data is processed about you and to exercise your rights. </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">This policy explains how we <a href="#_heading=h.2df0tsb6ilfb"><strong>collect</strong></a> (including the <a href="#_heading=h.2df0tsb6ilfb"><strong>sources</strong></a><strong> </strong>of collection), <a href="#_heading=h.2df0tsb6ilfb"><strong>use</strong></a>, <a href="#_heading=h.2df0tsb6ilfb"><strong>disclose</strong></a>, and <a href="#_heading=h.9omdbjy3cnos"><strong>retain</strong></a><strong> </strong>information about you in connection with our platforms. <strong><a href="#table-1">This table</a></strong> explains this same information, including the categories of personal information we collect, the types of entities to which we disclose it, and the ways we use each category of information, as required by certain State Privacy Laws. The table explains our practices today and over the preceding 12 months.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">In some cases, we may de-identify personal information so that it no longer identifies you and use this information for purposes like analyzing the effectiveness of the Services. We will use this information in de-identified form and we will not attempt to reidentify it, unless required by law.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">We do not knowingly process the personal information of consumers we know to be under the age of 18 for targeted advertising purposes, nor do we sell or share such information.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><em><strong>Special Disclosures for Residents of Texas</strong></em></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>The entity maintaining this website is a data broker under Texas law. Notice: We may sell (as defined under Texas law) your sensitive personal data.</strong></p>

</div></section>


<p class="wp-block-paragraph">To note, Magnite participates in the IAB Europe Transparency & Consent Framework and complies with its specifications and policies. Magnite’s registration number(s) within the framework are 52 (Magnite, Inc.) and 493 (Magnite – Carbon AI).</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Magnite is a member of the Network Advertising Initiative (“NAI”). For more information about how targeted advertising works, you can visit the <a href="https://thenai.org/about-online-advertising/how-does-it-work/"><strong>NAI educational page</strong></a>.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Finally, Magnite adheres to the Digital Advertising Alliance (“DAA”) Self-Regulatory Principles, and the European Digital Advertising Alliance’s (“EDAA”) Self-Regulatory Principles</p>


<section class="core-heading"><div class="container max-w-1144px">
<h1 class="wp-block-heading" id="data-transfers-and-eu-u-s-data-privacy-framework-uk-extension-to-the-eu-us-data-privacy-framework-and-swiss-u-s-data-privacy-principles"><strong>Data Transfers and EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, UK Extension to the EU-US Data Privacy Framework, and Swiss-U.S Data Privacy Principles:</strong></h1>
</div></section>


<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Magnite is a global company headquartered in the United States, with offices and data centers around the world. If you access Digital Media Properties, your data may be transferred to, stored and processed by us in countries outside the United States, and by those third parties with whom we may share your User Information (as described in this policy) in the countries in which they operate.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Some countries may not provide a level of data protection for User Information that is equivalent to the data protection laws in your country. We will however implement appropriate safeguards where the Magnite group of companies, or any third parties with whom we share data, receive User Information originating from the EEA, Switzerland or the UK in accordance with applicable data protection legislation.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Magnite, Inc. and its US subsidiary, Magnite Hopper, Inc., commit to comply with the EU-US, the UK extension and Swiss-US Data Privacy Frameworks as set forth by the US Department of Commerce with respect to personal information concerning individuals from the EEA, UK and Switzerland. If there is any conflict between the terms in this Privacy Policy and the Data Privacy Framework Principles, the Data Privacy Framework Principles shall govern.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">If you would like to learn more about the safeguards we put in place for international transfers, please see our <a href="https://www.magnite.com/legal/data-protection-framework/"><strong>Data Privacy Framework Notice</strong></a> to learn more or contact us using the contact details further below.</p>

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The data controller indicated above is responsible for transparency and compliance measures under the LGPD. Other responsibilities are detailed in the BR SCCs. </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">We may transfer your personal data in the course of administering and providing our Services as described in this Privacy Policy. Magnite will adopt appropriate safeguards, in accordance with the provisions of the LGPD and any other applicable law / regulation. </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The Personal Data may be transferred to perform our Services, and it may be shared with Magnite Affiliates and our clients and partners for the purposes of providing our Services and as described in this Privacy Policy. </p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">You, as a Data Subject, have the right, as regards the Personal Data subject to the data transfer governed by the BR SCCs, at any time, and upon request by contacting us, going to our<strong> <a href="https://www.magnite.com/legal/user-choice-portal/">User Choice Portal</a></strong>, or referring to the section above under<strong> <a href="#your-privacy-rights-and-choices">“Your Privacy Rights and Choices”</a></strong>, and including information on the consequences of denying consent, and request a copy of our BR SCCs free of charge.</p>

policy explains how Magnite, Inc. and its affiliates (“ Magnite ”, “ we ” or “ us ”) collects, uses and discloses information about you when you interact with Digital Media Properties (defined below) that use our advertising technology platforms and related services to deliver you ads (collectively, the “ Services ”).  This privacy policy does not govern (i) the collection and use of information about visitors to our website , or (ii) information collected in the course of our sales and marketing activities. Our privacy practices as to that information can be found here . This policy does not cover how our Clients collect, use, or share information through their own Digital Media Properties . It also does not apply to the activities of other third parties we may work with, or any activities where we act as a service provider or processor to our Clients rather than a data controller. Those practices are governed by our Clients’ own privacy policies. About Us Magnite offers Services that connect buyers of advertising inventory (which we refer to as advertisers) with sellers of advertising inventory (which we refer to as publishers), providing such advertisers with the opportunity to display an advertisement on a publisher’s Digital Media Property. In this policy, we refer to our advertisers and publishers that use our Services collectively as “ Clients ”. Our platform is used to deliver digital advertising inventory on websites and applications across internet-connected devices and platforms, including mobile devices, computers and internet-connected TVs (which we refer to as “ Digital Media Properties” ). How We Collect User Information We (and our vendors) use different technologies (“ Tracking Technologies ”), including cookies and other similar technologies to collect information automatically from your device when you visit a Digital Media Property that uses our technology.  When doing so, we collect certain information about you and your device (“ User Information ”). User Information does not include information that directly identifies an individual, such as name, address, phone number, or email address. However, the User Information we collect is considered “personal data” or “personal information” under applicable privacy and data protection laws. In particular, we collect information such as your IP address, cookie data, and other device identifiers, and may also assign new identifiers to your device or browser based on this data and other device-related information we collect as described in more detail here . These identifiers help us to recognize a particular device without knowing the identity of the user of that device. This helps us, our Clients, and our partners (such as third party advertising platforms) select appropriate advertisements to display to you. Information Our Clients and Vendors Collect Independently  We collaborate with various third-parties for analytics and advertising services, which independently gather and use User Information. These third-party services provide our Clients with additional ways to deliver targeted ads using our technology. For example, third-party companies may use data about your visits to Digital Media Properties across multiple devices or browsers to create advertising profiles that allow advertisers to deliver more personalized content and ads. Our advertiser clients can combine this data with the information we collect to deliver targeted ads or create audience segments for advertising on Digital Media Properties. Please review our  Platform Partner Statement  for more information. Use of User Information We and our Clients use User Information to guide decisions on buying and selling advertising space on Digital Media Properties. This data, which may also be combined with information from third-party services, helps deliver targeted ads that our Clients believe will interest specific users. When an ad is shown on a publisher’s Digital Media Property, it may also be targeted based on the content that you are viewing or have viewed, for example a travel ad appearing on a travel site. Tracking Technologies help to match Client’s advertising opportunities with relevant advertisements. To aid with ad targeting, we may perform cookie syncing between Clients, Magnite, and third party data providers and assist Clients in matching the IDs they hold to other IDs. This cookie synching process allows the parties to map their respective cookie information. For example, if publisher A sets a cookie on a user’s device with an ID 12345 and advertiser B sets a cookie on the same user’s device with an ID 67890, this process allows  publisher A and advertiser B to recognize that ID 12345 and ID 67890 relate to the same user’s device. In the case of advertisers, this process may influence the decision whether to bid on a specific advertising opportunity, because if an advertiser recognizes a given cookie ID it may place a higher value on that opportunity.  We also use these Tracking Technologies for frequency capping, which helps prevent users from seeing the same ad repeatedly, enhancing ad delivery, report to clients, and assess ad effectiveness. The use and processing of User Information described in this section may constitute “targeted advertising” under some laws and the “sale” or “sharing” of personal information under other laws. Cooperation with Clients in the European Union In the European Union, we and our Clients may, in limited circumstances, act as joint controllers under the GDPR for the collection of User Information on Digital Media Properties. In this case, this joint controllership is limited to setting and collecting identifiers and User Information on the Digital Media Properties and transmitting this information to us (“ Joint Processing “). Further processing of your information is our sole responsibility and we act as an independent controller. We have put contractual arrangements in place with our Clients that set out the distribution of responsibilities between us and our Client. Accordingly, our Clients establish the necessary legal basis for this Joint Processing by obtaining consent on the Digital Media Properties and providing the required transparency information. We and our Clients cooperate to fulfill our obligations under the GDPR, especially regarding collaboration with data protection authorities and data subject rights. If you wish to exercise your rights under the GDPR concerning Joint Processing, please contact us via the User Choice Portal . User Information We Collect, Use, Disclose, and the Purposes for such Disclosure: Types of User Information we collect: Depending on the Digital Media Properties you visit and how they interact with our Services, we may process the following categories of User Information:                                              Device Characteristics : device identifiers, IP addresses, hashed versions of email addresses, probabilistic identifiers and other advertising identifiers. Browsing and Interaction Data : information about the domain, topic or name of the property, the date/time of visits, visitor activities and actions, viewability data, video player size, description or category being displayed, click data, types of advertisements viewed, type of browser you use, app version, and the page you visited before navigating to the Digital Media Properties. Users Profiles, User behavior data, derived information : user demographics, information with respect to a user’s preferences, patterns, clicks, behaviors or interests, and information provided to us by advertisers and advertising platforms to match an advertisement opportunity offered by our Clients with the right advertisement. Non-precise Location data: An approximation of a location, such as country and/or city, state/province using the IP address. Precise Location Data (which is “sensitive personal information” under certain State Privacy Laws): An approximation of a location within a radius of 1850 feet or less. It will be used only with your consent and in jurisdictions where permitted. Purposes of processing and Recipients of User Information The categories and types of User Information we collect and process are found in the below chart along with the third parties that we share this data with. When you visit Digital Media Properties that use our technology, we collect, use and disclose the following User Information to the listed recipients for the indicated purposes:  Category & Types of User Information we collect Categories of Recipients   We may disclose personal information to… Purposes   We use personal information to… Device characteristics   • Our Clients; • Magnite Affiliates; • Our vendors and service providers; • Our Partners; • In connection with a business transfer; • Law enforcement or others in legal proceeding;   • Store and Access information on a device • Use limited data to select advertising • Create profiles for targeted/personalized advertising; • Use profiles to select targeted/personalized advertising; • Measure advertising performance;  • Develop and improve services; • Ensure security, prevent and detect fraud, and fix errors; • Deliver and present advertising; • Save and communicate privacy choices. Such use is limited strictly to the stated purposes. No additional purposes are pursued, and no personal data is used for training purposes. Some jurisdictions may require consent in order to collect and process personal data. In all situations where you have been specifically asked by our Clients or by us for your consent prior to processing, we may rely on that consent until you withdraw it. If we rely on consent to collect and/or process your User Information, we will obtain such consent in accordance with applicable law, including, among other things, responding to data subject access requests. Your Privacy Rights and Choices Opt-Out Depending upon where you live, certain activities described here may constitute “sharing” “selling” or processing of User Information for purposes of “targeted advertising” as such terms are defined under certain privacy laws. You may opt out of these activities, as well as processing of any sensitive personal information we may undertake by following the instructions in our  User Choice Portal , or by using a legally recognized universal opt out mechanism such as the Global Privacy Control . Note that because these opt outs are specific to the device or browser on which they are exercised, you will need to opt out on each browser and device you use. Access, Deletion, Correction, Portability, Withdrawal of Consent & other Rights Depending on where you reside and other legal limitations, you may have the right to (i) request to know more about and access the categories and specific pieces of User Information we collect, use, and disclose, (ii) request deletion or restriction of your User Information, (iii) request correction of inaccurate User Information, (iv) obtain your User Information in a portable format, (v) if the processing is based on our legitimate interest, object to the processing and/or (vi) if the processing of User Information is based on your consent, withdraw your consent at any time, (vii) confirm the existence of processing, as applicable.  If you would like to exercise any of these rights, please see our  User Choice Portal  for instructions on how to do so. If you are a resident of California or of the EEA, you may also exercise these rights using an authorized agent. We may ask the agent to present signed written permission to act on your behalf and you may also be required to independently verify your identity. If you are an agent seeking to make a request, please contact us here . We will not discriminate against you for exercising these rights. Note that when you exercise your rights, we may ask for additional information to verify your request. Right to Lodge a Complaint if you are a User in the EEA, UK, or Switzerland : You have the right to lodge a complaint about our processing of personal data with a European Data Protection Authority. For contact details of EU data protection authorities, please see here . The UK data protection authority can be contacted here . The Swiss data protection authority can be contacted here . If you are a User in Brazil : You have the right to lodge a complaint about our processing of personal data with the National Data Protection Agency (ANPD). For contact details of the ANPD, please see here . Y our Rights under certain State Laws If you are a resident of a state governed by a State Privacy Law , please see our User Choice Portal   section above to exercise your rights. If we deny your request, you may have the right to appeal our decision by contacting us here . If you have concerns about the result of an appeal, you may contact the attorney general in the state where you reside. Authorized Agents Depending upon where you live, you may also submit a rights request through an authorized agent. If you do so, the agent must present signed written permission to act on your behalf and you may also be required to independently verify your identity. If you are an agent seeking to make a request, please contact us here . Additional Information for Residents of Certain States Certain states, including Alabama, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Indiana, Kentucky, Louisiana, Iowa, Minnesota, Maryland, Montana, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Jersey, Oklahoma, Oregon, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, and Virginia, have enacted consumer privacy laws that grant their residents certain rights and require additional disclosures (“ State Privacy Laws ”). If you are a resident of a state governed by a State Privacy Law this section applies to you. This section also serves as our California Notice at Collection. As a reminder, disclosures do not apply to the extent we act as a service provider or processor to our Clients. In such cases, you must visit the privacy policies of our Clients to understand how data is processed about you and to exercise your rights.  This policy explains how we collect (including the sources of collection), use , disclose , and retain information about you in connection with our platforms. This table explains this same information, including the categories of personal information we collect, the types of entities to which we disclose it, and the ways we use each category of information, as required by certain State Privacy Laws. The table explains our practices today and over the preceding 12 months. In some cases, we may de-identify personal information so that it no longer identifies you and use this information for purposes like analyzing the effectiveness of the Services. We will use this information in de-identified form and we will not attempt to reidentify it, unless required by law. We do not knowingly process the personal information of consumers we know to be under the age of 18 for targeted advertising purposes, nor do we sell or share such information. Special Disclosures for Residents of Texas The entity maintaining this website is a data broker under Texas law. Notice: We may sell (as defined under Texas law) your sensitive personal data. Annual Request Statistics  During the period from January 1, 2025 to December 31, 2025, we received the following number of requests from individuals and responded to these requests to delete and know were completed in a median time of 8 days and an average time of 11 days. These requests came from individuals globally, inclusive of the United States: Requests to know from individuals globally, inclusive of the United States and other countries: 29 requests. 4 of these requests were completed. 25 requests were not completed because we were unable to verify the identity of the individual making the request or did not have the information provided from the individual making the request. Requests to delete from individuals globally, inclusive of the US and other countries: 72 requests. 1 was completed, and 71 requests were not completed as we did not have any information relating to the information provided from the individual making the request. In addition to these rights, as noted above, we allow individuals requests to opt out of interest-based or targeted advertising and any potential sales and shares of personal information, as explained in this Policy. Individuals exercise these rights through automated means such as visiting our opt out page and accessing our opt out cookie, or through their mobile devices or through our partners. Our records indicate that we received 2,223,801 such opt out requests. When we see any such opt out signals, we opt the user out in approximately real time. Information Retention We store the User Information we collect for as long as is necessary for the purpose(s) for which we originally collected it, or for other legitimate business purposes, including to meet our legal, regulatory, or other compliance obligations. We typically store the User Information we collect from your device, such as IP address and other information described above, in our systems for up to 90 days before we anonymize and aggregate that data into summary reports. Security We use industry-standard technical and organizational security measures designed to help protect information transmitted over or stored on our systems. Industry Framework & Self-regulatory mechanisms To note, Magnite participates in the IAB Europe Transparency & Consent Framework and complies with its specifications and policies. Magnite’s registration number(s) within the framework are 52 (Magnite, Inc.) and 493 (Magnite – Carbon AI). Magnite is a member of the Network Advertising Initiative (“NAI”). For more information about how targeted advertising works, you can visit the NAI educational page . Finally, Magnite adheres to the Digital Advertising Alliance (“DAA”) Self-Regulatory Principles, and the European Digital Advertising Alliance’s (“EDAA”) Self-Regulatory Principles Data Transfers and EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, UK Extension to the EU-US Data Privacy Framework, and Swiss-U.S Data Privacy Principles: Magnite is a global company headquartered in the United States, with offices and data centers around the world. If you access Digital Media Properties, your data may be transferred to, stored and processed by us in countries outside the United States, and by those third parties with whom we may share your User Information (as described in this policy) in the countries in which they operate. Some countries may not provide a level of data protection for User Information that is equivalent to the data protection laws in your country. We will however implement appropriate safeguards where the Magnite group of companies, or any third parties with whom we share data, receive User Information originating from the EEA, Switzerland or the UK in accordance with applicable data protection legislation. Magnite, Inc. and its US subsidiary, Magnite Hopper, Inc., commit to comply with the EU-US, the UK extension and Swiss-US Data Privacy Frameworks as set forth by the US Department of Commerce with respect to personal information concerning individuals from the EEA, UK and Switzerland. If there is any conflict between the terms in this Privacy Policy and the Data Privacy Framework Principles, the Data Privacy Framework Principles shall govern. If you would like to learn more about the safeguards we put in place for international transfers, please see our  Data Privacy Framework Notice  to learn more or contact us using the contact details further below. International Data Transfers from Brazil This notice is applicable to the extent that Magnite performs international personal data transfers that are subject to the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13,709/2018 – “LGPD”). This notice describes, in a simple and accessible manner, the information required under RESOLUTION CD/ANPD No. 19, of August 23, 2024 (the International Data Transfer Regulation – the “Regulation”), where an international transfer is carried out based on the Brazilian standard contractual clauses (“BR SCCs”) approved by the ANPD. The data controller indicated above is responsible for transparency and compliance measures under the LGPD. Other responsibilities are detailed in the BR SCCs.  We may transfer your personal data in the course of administering and providing our Services as described in this Privacy Policy. Magnite will adopt appropriate safeguards, in accordance with the provisions of the LGPD and any other applicable law / regulation.  The Personal Data may be transferred to perform our Services, and it may be shared with Magnite Affiliates and our clients and partners for the purposes of providing our Services and as described in this Privacy Policy.  You, as a Data Subject, have the right, as regards the Personal Data subject to the data transfer governed by the BR SCCs, at any time, and upon request by contacting us, going to our User Choice Portal , or referring to the section above under “Your Privacy Rights and Choices” , and including information on the consequences of denying consent, and request a copy of our BR SCCs free of charge. Changes to this Policy We may update this policy from time to time in order to reflect, for example, changes to our practices or for other operational, legal or regulatory reasons. If we make material changes to this policy, we will notify you of any material changes by posting the revised policy on this website, and where necessary, by any other means required by applicable law. Contact Us For more information about our privacy practices, if you have questions, or if you would like to make a complaint, please contact Magnite’s Privacy Team by e-mail at  [email protected]  or by post using the details provided below: 1250 Broadway, 15th Floor, New York, New York 10001 You can also contact Magnite’s Data Protection Officer at  [email protected] . If you are based in the EU you can contact our EU Representative: [email protected] Lionheart Squared (Europe) Ltd (FAO – Magnite), 2 Pembroke House, Upper Pembroke Street 28-32, Dublin, DO2 EK84, Republic of Ireland.
